purpose: Regression and accuracy evaluation for the DriveRent chatbot. Evaluation only: none of these questions are used for training, and scripts/evaluate_chatbot.py reports any overlap with data/chatbot_intents.json.
provenance: Author-written cases (synthetic questions). Expected facts were checked against the application code, the OBDex reference and data/knowledge/system_guide.json on 2026-10-31. They have not yet been reviewed by a second person; set review_status to human_reviewed after review. Regression cases reg-* were added on 2026-10-31 for problems found by Back-End-routed testing; their expected facts were checked against the same sources. On 2026-10-31 the evaluation moved to the database-grounded flow (plan, Back-End ChatRetrieval on a fixture database, grounded answer); changed expectations are noted on each case.

verified_evidence_records.inspection_findings: Rear O2 sensor signal mirrors front

diagnostic_context.measurement_policy: No live sensor telemetry or component test readings are available. Do not infer condition, measurements, or faults.
